headline: Global Stocks Retreat as Oil Rally and French Turmoil Pressure Sentiment
summary: Wall Street and European equities retreated as oil prices reached a five-month high. The S&P 500 fell 0.5%, the Dow shed 1.2%, and Europe's Stoxx 600 dropped 1.4% for the week amid rising French political risk.
why: Elevated energy prices stoke inflation concerns, limiting central banks' scope to loosen monetary policy and pressuring corporate margins globally.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Five-month highs in crude oil boost revenue and cash flow outlooks for energy producers.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: Surging fuel costs renew inflation worries and weigh on broader equity valuations.

why_moved: Major equity indices declined in response to oil hitting five-month peaks alongside European fiscal tensions.
